notes.title: Important Update Regarding Demo
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've identified an issue with the EasySave plugin that was preventing some of you from launching the demo. We've temporarily disabled it to get the demo running smoothly again.

What this means for you right now:

The demo should now launch without any issues related to EasySave.
However, please be aware that your settings edits not be saved during this time. We're actively reaching out to the developers of the EasySave plugin to get this resolved as quickly as possible so we can re-enable saving functionality.

In the meantime, please don't hesitate to let us know if you encounter any other problems or have any feedback on the demo. Your input is invaluable!

Thanks for your understanding and patience as we work through this.
